messages:
alex: Follow-up: we need a minimal adapter probe + capability response for hosted/dedicated/private onboarding. Too many teams are adding bespoke fields and it's biting us on upgrades.

maya: I'm picturing a small JSON-RPC or HTTP probe: /capabilities returns supported fields + semantics, /authorize(token) returns principal + mode, /translate(manifest) returns a sanitized runtime plan (no secrets).

omar: important: capability response must advertise egress constraints and kms_mode so runtime can decide: allow_controlplane_egress, allowed_telemetry_schemes, kms_handoff=true/false.

alex: agree. also include an explicit compatibility_version integer so we can evolve the contract without silent breakage.

lucy: telemetry note: adapters should expose a bounded in-memory queue size and drop strategy in /capabilities. otherwise on-prem agents hit memory blowups when telemetry endpoints are slow. document retry policy.
maria: (typo correction) maya meant to say: include supported_error_codes list so control-plane can map to fallbacks (e.g., RETRYABLE_CAPACITY, AUTHZ_DENIED).

jen: ops ask: adapters must expose /diagnostics?request_id=<id> that returns last_decision for that id (timestamped), useful for support and for customers running private. Read-only, sanitized.

alex: implementation guidance: translate(manifest) should NEVER include plaintext secrets. If manifest needs creds, adapter returns secret_ref tokens and a local resolution flow is used by runtime (eg local KMS plugin). add this to the RFC.

omar: CI note: adapter contract tests should be runnable in a small harness that control-plane runs on PRs. tests: probe shape, basic auth flows, telemetry backpressure, kms_handshake sequence.

lucy: backlog item: we should define a recommended per-request timeout for adapter calls (e.g., 250ms for auth, 1s for translate) and define how runtime should fallback when adapter is slow. that prevents user-facing latencies.

adapter-bot: Reminder: capability-contract-tests failing in staging for adapter "acme-private" (job 4412). tagging @omar and @jen. :rotating_light:

omar: I'll grab the logs and try to reproduce. looks like translate hung when the runtime sent a larger manifest; we may need pagination or streaming for very large manifests.

maya: good catch. v1 of the contract should call out max manifest size (e.g., 16KB) and require either streaming or a 413-like error code for larger payloads. keep v1 simple.

alex: action items: maya -> draft RFC with interface spec + example shim; omar -> collect CI logs and propose contract tests; jen -> draft diagnostics endpoint spec and customer-facing guidance; lucy -> telemetry backpressure doc. aim for v1 landing in ~2 weeks. :thumbsup:
